entries.title: Psalms 88:1
segments: ¶<A Song. A Psalm. Of the sons of Korah. To the chief music-maker; put to Mahalath Leannoth. Maschil. Of Heman the Ezrahite. O Lord, God of my salvation, I have been crying to you for help by day and by night:

entries.title: Psalms 88:2
segments: Let my prayer come before you; give ear to my cry:

entries.title: Psalms 88:3
segments: For my soul is full of evils, and my life has come near to the underworld.

entries.title: Psalms 88:4
segments: I am numbered among those who go down into the earth; I have become like a man for whom there is no help:

entries.title: Psalms 88:5
segments: My soul is among the dead, like those in the underworld, to whom you give no more thought; for they are cut off from your care.

entries.title: Psalms 88:6
segments: You have put me in the lowest deep, even in dark places.

entries.title: Psalms 88:7
segments: The weight of your wrath is crushing me, all your waves have overcome me. (Selah.)

entries.title: Psalms 88:8
segments: You have sent my friends far away from me; you have made me a disgusting thing in their eyes: I am shut up, and not able to come out.

entries.title: Psalms 88:9
segments: My eyes are wasting away because of my trouble: Lord, my cry has gone up to you every day, my hands are stretched out to you.

entries.title: Psalms 88:10
segments: ¶Will you do works of wonder for the dead? will the shades come back to give you praise? (Selah.)

entries.title: Psalms 88:11
segments: Will the story of your mercy be given in the house of the dead? will news of your faith come to the place of destruction?

entries.title: Psalms 88:12
segments: May there be knowledge of your wonders in the dark? or of your righteousness where memory is dead?

entries.title: Psalms 88:13
segments: But to you did I send up my cry, O Lord; in the morning my prayer came before you.

entries.title: Psalms 88:14
segments: Lord, why have you sent away my soul? why is your face covered from me?

entries.title: Psalms 88:15
segments: I have been troubled and in fear of death from the time when I was young; your wrath is hard on me, and I have no strength.

entries.title: Psalms 88:16
segments: The heat of your wrath has gone over me; I am broken by your cruel punishments.

entries.title: Psalms 88:17
segments: They are round me all the day like water; they have made a circle about me.

entries.title: Psalms 88:18
segments: You have sent my friends and lovers far from me; I am gone from the memory of those who are dear to me.
